name: Coupons And Deals
tagline: Clips your stores' coupons and reads the circular before you shop
description: Ahead of a grocery run it gathers your stores' digital coupons, turns loyalty points into savings at the till, hunts down printable offers, and goes through the weekly circular so anything on special is already on your list.
author: jacobgay1989
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
